Bold.Description: This is used to make the font bold.

Parameters.Description: Bold: Yes - makes the font bold; else the font will be normal.

Bold.Name: Bold

Font.Description: It specifies the supported font name.

Parameters.Description: It decides the type of font.

Height.Description: It specifies the height of the letter.

Parameters.Description: It decides the height of the font. The height is always measured in points. The value for the attribute height can have fractions and can be denoted by a formula, which returns a number.

Height.Name: Height

Italic.Description: This is used to make the font italic.

Parameters.Description: Italic: Yes - makes the font italic.

Italic.Name: Italic

Parameters.Description: It acts as label for grouping.
